description: Preview status, archive, delete, name, budget, bid including minimum ROAS, schedule, spend-limit, targeting, ad set settings and set_creative edits. Targeting is patched; use ads_search_targeting for IDs and request detail: full to inspect the full resulting audience in the preview. To change an image or video, create a new ad in the Uploader. At most 10 creative edits per plan. Show ENGAGEMENT_RESET prominently: likes, comments and shares stay with the old post. Supports placement-customised creatives (for example a 4:5 feed + 9:16 story/reels pair) and multi-media dynamic asset feeds while preserving media and routing. Multiple text rows require texts arrays; labelled rows require the same count and order. Non-carousel placement feeds allow one description; multi-CTA edits are refused. Carousels (plain and placement-customised) support primary text, whole-carousel link/CTA/display link/URL tags and per-card headline/description/link via cards[{card, headline, description, link}]; per-card links are refused on placement-customised carousels. Unsupported flexible, catalog, partnership, language or segment customization, and unknown asset-feed optimization types return precise reasons; relaunch with ads_create (CLI: ads create) using the same media or the Uploader copy-settings-from-this-ad flow. Review mode queues proposals without Meta validation; Meta decides at apply and results show per item. Edits that already match Meta return NO_CHANGE warnings; when every change already matches, review mode queues nothing and returns nothingQueued: true with no reviewId or reviewUrl, so tell the user nothing needs approval. Default previews summarize items and group warnings; detail: full includes changes and details. Passing reviewId moves identical pending suggestions from other reviews into that review (their old copies are cancelled); without reviewId identical pending suggestions are reused where they are. Pass idempotencyKey and reuse the same key on retry after a timeout; PREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS means retry in a few seconds. Does not change Meta. Direct plans expire in 15 minutes. Existing review reads and approvals cover seven days after the last update; use ads_list_inbox_history for retained history up to 90 days. Both preview detail levels report settings.launch (allowed, approval or off) separately from the edit mode; settings.approvalRuleAppliesTo is edits. Edit approval does not gate new-ad launches. Review mode returns reviewUrl and no executable plan. Share reviewUrl with the user, do not apply, and reuse reviewId on later previews in the same conversation. EDITS_REVIEW_REQUIRED means approval must happen in your Agent Inbox. Always preview and show the user the changes. Set a confirm flag only after the user explicitly approves that change. Never retry a partial apply blindly. Archive and delete cannot be undone. Preview requests accept optional reason and runTitle. A per-operation reason overrides the top-level reason for that operation. Use one short evidence-based note for the Agent Inbox and reuse runTitle with the same reviewId.
